title: The Knight Cannot Cover Twice
setup: Black's knight on c7 is watching e8, your rook has reached the seventh, and the queen is waiting on e2.
hint: A knight guards awkwardly. Find the square it can reach exactly once and make it go there.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Re8+}} demands the knight, {{Nxe8}} is forced, and the queen captures it there with {{Qxe8#}}. A knight defending a square is only a defender until it has to stand on it.
